title: Sparse current function graphs give a runtime-independent full-step HF footprint

statement.quantifiers: Every fixed deterministic finite-support FS24 ASM with fixed signature/arities and closed finite rule, extended only with standard BGS ordinal Card; every finite legal run of inclusive hereditary peak Active size W.
statement.assertion: One fixed HF term exactly simulates prefixes, halting and Boolean outputs at peak full eager-evaluation footprint <=C_M(4+W)^d_M independently of elapsed runtime.
assumptions: Encode only nonzero current tuples, with actual HF tags/Kuratowski tuples; no accumulated update history or unbounded step ordinal.
All parallel updates evaluate on the frozen source state, including zeros and non-Boolean guard semantics.
Atom Card=Empty, set Card=von Neumann ordinal; fixed syntactic depth/arity constants charged.

inputs: Supplied fixed finite rule/signature and legal finite-support source semantics; hereditary input/state support.
outputs: One fixed equivariant HF simulation term and full transient-footprint polynomial, not merely an output encoding.
interface.precision: Exact mathematical encoding; no generated full machine syntax or executed compiler.
costs: Graph tuples have polynomial count W^r for fixed arity r.
All projections, comprehensions, Card ordinals and unused eagerly evaluated branches included in the fixed-syntax polynomial.
An invariant input query lower bound still imports independent group/base/HF transfer hypotheses.

proof_mechanism: Store only nondefault graphs with tagged roots; preserve inclusive hereditary closure.
Translate terms/guards over frozen graphs and bound every temporary recursively by fixed syntax.
Construct simultaneous update tuples; detect any clash on the whole update set.
Keep zero updates until removal of old keys, collapse identical duplicates, and return unchanged source state on clash.
Compose a bounded-size next-state term with no elapsed-time accumulation; polynomial source-space guard implies polynomial HF peak.
obstructions: Original FS24 excludes Card; its parity example cannot be reused after adding Card on atoms/sets.
Solvability/rank primitives are outside the Card-only lower-bound contract.
No unrestricted logical-model or conventional bit-space separation follows.

potential_uses.target: Transferring invariant state-size lower bounds to native machines
potential_uses.transfer_gate: Prove the precise eager intermediate-footprint contract and source semantic preservation; separately validate all lower-bound imports.

review.source_reported: Source-scoped analytic derivations, independent reconstruction for counting/logarithm, and finite checks reported; Hamiltonian proof has source-reported review only; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
